scope: Independent read-only review of the exact C11 local snapshot: C10 administrative workspace/recovery corrections plus workspace-specific session membership resolution and complete frozen-bar provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Every volatile admin create, update, deactivate and reset operation is scoped to the actor exact tenant and workspace; sibling-workspace actors cannot mutate a target or its state.
Volatile creation uses the actor workspace; unsupported workspace transfer is rejected; rejected operations do not partially mutate records.
Last-active-administrator demotion and deactivation protection counts administrators only in the exact actor workspace and remains correct under concurrent local mutations.

Deactivation changes only the selected membership, preserves global account status and credentials, revokes only sessions bound to that tenant/workspace, and leaves sibling memberships/sessions unchanged.

Session validation resolves the exact tenant/workspace membership, accepts active sessions in multiple workspaces of one tenant, rejects mismatches/inactive memberships, and defaults a legacy session with no workspace_id to the documented default scope.
PostgreSQL recovery locks the global account and exact membership in a consistent order, verifies active membership under lock, and updates credentials plus session revocation in one transaction.

Real PostgreSQL concurrency evidence shows recovery and deactivation serialize correctly: deactivation waits for an in-flight recovery, while a previously committed deactivation makes recovery fail and roll back token consumption.

Recovery replay and inactive-membership attempts are rejected without password/session side effects or token consumption on rollback; successful recovery revokes every session for the global user, including multiple same-tenant workspaces.
The admin API exposes membership status separately from global account status, and the UI renders inactive membership/action state correctly with regression coverage.

Listed tests and controls substantiate this exact local snapshot only; verify the frozen quality bar artifact and its embedded source snapshot against the hash-listed source, verify the separate static quality-bar input, and keep production/product/release/promotion acceptance open.

limitations: Local scoped evidence only. API authentication uses test dependency overrides and does not prove deployed authentication. The in-memory adapter holds one membership per user and its RLock coordinates only threads in one process; PostgreSQL is the durable multi-workspace path. Integrated production worker/runtime, operational monitoring/recovery, domain/provider/corpus acceptance, representative RAG quality, visual/accessibility, release and promotion remain open.
